applyTo: "frontend/**,web/**"

# Frontend instructions

Future interfaces are operational/read-only by default. Display data freshness and
execution mode prominently. Never store private keys or signing secrets client-side,
and never expose a path around deterministic risk. Dangerous actions require clear,
specific operator intent, server-side authorization, confirmation, audit records,
and honest pending/unknown states. Do not imply profitability or certainty.
